line.town.tc_friend_young.1: I'm friends with {6}. We're building a hideout together, only shh!
line.town.tc_friend_young.2: {3} has real binoculars. I get to have a look.
line.town.tc_friend_elder.1: {2} comes round for tea on Wednesdays. We've known each other for ages and still argue.
line.town.tc_friend_elder.2: Tell {4} if you get the chance: I'm still the better draughts player.
line.town.tc_kin_son.1: {2} is growing by the hour. New shoes yesterday, too small already.
line.town.tc_kin_son.2: {6} needs watching every minute. A kind boy, though.
line.town.tc_kin_daughter.1: {2} is our clever one. She reads faster than I can buy books.
line.town.tc_kin_daughter.2: Never a dull day with {6}. Yesterday she brought home a hedgehog.
line.town.tc_kin_mum.1: My mum's {2}. She's nice, she just makes me eat soup.
line.town.tc_kin_mum.2: Mum says home by supper. And {3} is best obeyed.
line.town.tc_kin_dad.1: My dad's {2}. He can fix anything, even a bike.
line.town.tc_kin_dad.2: Dad and I go to the sea at weekends. All the fishermen know him: "Morning, {2}!"
line.town.tc_kin_sister.1: My sister's {2}. A pest, but she'll stand up for me if it comes to it.
line.town.tc_kin_sister.2: {6} and I share a room. The border runs along the rug.
line.town.tc_kin_brother.1: My brother's {2}. We fight every day and get bored apart.
line.town.tc_kin_brother.2: {2} promised to teach me to dive. I'm waiting for summer.
line.town.tc_kin_wife.1: My wife, {2}, says I talk too much. She's right.
line.town.tc_kin_wife.2: {6} and I walk down to the sea every evening. A habit.
line.town.tc_kin_husband.1: My husband, {2}, has his mind on fishing again. But he's pure gold.
line.town.tc_kin_husband.2: {6} and I go to the market on Saturdays. He haggles, I blush.
line.town.tc_kin_mate.1: I share the flat with {6}. We take turns with the dishes. In theory.
line.town.tc_kin_mate.2: {6} is easy to live with: quiet, and the tea's always made.
line.town.tc_hobby_play_club.1: I like a game at the club. Time goes sideways in there.
line.town.tc_hobby_play_club.2: Evenings, the computer. Not a word to anyone: I'm a serious person.
line.town.tc_hobby_night_walk.1: I like walking at night. The town's quiet and the lamps are all yours.
line.town.tc_hobby_night_walk.2: One thinks best by the sea at night.
line.town.tc_hobby_watch_sunrise.1: I'm up before dawn to watch the sun come out of the sea.
line.town.tc_hobby_watch_sunrise.2: Sunrise here is free and hardly anyone comes. Do come.
line.town.tc_hobby_fish_shore.1: A rod on the shore: that's the thing for me.
line.town.tc_hobby_fish_shore.2: Fishing. Whether they bite is beside the point.
line.town.tc_hobby_stroll.1: A stroll along the promenade and back. Every day, any weather.
line.town.tc_hobby_stroll.2: I like to walk. A small town, yet something new each time.
line.town.tc_hobby_coffee.1: A cup of coffee in the café and nowhere to rush. A small happiness.
line.town.tc_hobby_coffee.2: Coffee. Without it I'm not a person, I'm a timetable.
line.town.tc_hobby_eat_out.1: I like eating out. Someone else's soup is always more interesting.
line.town.tc_hobby_eat_out.2: Our restaurant's good. The waiter will tell you what turned out well today.
line.town.tc_hobby_swim_look.1: Sitting by the water watching the swimmers. Brave people!
line.town.tc_hobby_swim_look.2: The sea. Just standing near it makes things easier.
line.town.tc_hobby_fair_visit.1: I love the fair. I'll buy nothing and handle everything.
line.town.tc_hobby_fair_visit.2: The fair has a carousel and gingerbread. What more is there?
line.town.tc_hobby_sea_air.1: Breathing the sea. Doctors recommend it; I knew without them.
line.town.tc_hobby_sea_air.2: Standing on the pier looking at the waves. I can do an hour.
line.town.tc_hobby_sit_bench.1: Sitting on a bench. It's not laziness, it's observation.
line.town.tc_hobby_sit_bench.2: I've a bench of my own. Come along, there's room.
line.town.tc_hobby_read_library.1: Reading. I've my own chair by the window in the library.
line.town.tc_hobby_read_library.2: Books. Take one for the evening and it's morning already.
line.town.tc_hobby_play_piano.1: I play the grand piano at the culture house. Come and listen, I don't bite.
line.town.tc_hobby_play_piano.2: Music. The fingers remember what the head forgot long ago.
line.town.tc_town.1: Go up to the lighthouse. The whole town lies in your palm from there.
line.town.tc_town.2: The market in the morning has the freshest news. And curd cheese.
line.town.tc_town.3: The promenade at sunset. I'll recommend nothing else.
line.town.tc_town.4: Take the cable car and look down. The town's quite different from above.
line.town.tc_town_young.1: The playground has a slide and swings! And the club has computers.
line.town.tc_town_young.2: The tide leaves shells on the beach. The prettiest are by the pier.
line.town.tc_town_elder.1: Tried the water at the sanatorium? Tastes bad, so it's good for you.
line.town.tc_town_elder.2: Go to the library. It's quiet and nobody lectures you.
line.town.tc_town_winter.1: In winter they flood a rink by the pond. Slippery, but fun.
line.town.tc_town_summer.1: In summer it's the beach, no question.
line.town.tc_ask_new.1: You're not from round here, are you? Where've you come from?
line.town.tc_ask_new.2: Wait, whose boy are you? I can't place you.
line.town.tc_reply_new_1.1: Ah, the computer club! They say nobody sleeps up there at all.
line.town.tc_reply_new_1.2: From up the hill, then. That's a climb. Well, welcome down here.
line.town.tc_reply_new_2.1: Walking's a fine thing. We've plenty of places for it.
line.town.tc_reply_new_2.2: Walk away, then. Just keep clear of the sea in a storm.
line.town.tc_ask_sea.1: Have you been down to the sea yet today?
line.town.tc_ask_sea.2: Been to the sea today? Any waves?
line.town.tc_reply_sea_1.1: Quite right. A day without the sea isn't a day.
line.town.tc_reply_sea_1.2: And how was it? Why do I ask: it's always fine.
line.town.tc_reply_sea_2.1: Do go. It waits, but not for ever.
line.town.tc_reply_sea_2.2: What do you mean, no? Drop everything and go. I mean it.
line.town.tc_ask_birds.1: They say you're fond of birds. Is it true?
line.town.tc_ask_birds.2: Is it you who watches the birds through binoculars?
line.town.tc_reply_birds_1.1: A fine thing. Birds are honest, unlike the barometer.
line.town.tc_reply_birds_1.2: Then don't forget a feeder in winter. The tits will remember.
line.town.tc_reply_birds_2.1: Computers! Well, they chirp too, in their way.
line.town.tc_reply_birds_2.2: Never mind, the birds will wait. They're patient.
line.town.tc_ask_like.1: And how do you like our town?
line.town.tc_ask_like.2: Do you like Lyudmilovsk? Honestly, now.
line.town.tc_reply_like_1.1: That's grand. The town can tell, you know.
line.town.tc_reply_like_1.2: I should think so. The sea, the cable car and nobody rushing you.
line.town.tc_reply_like_2.1: You'll get used to it. Quiet at first here, then like home.
line.town.tc_reply_like_2.2: Don't hurry. The town will choose you once it's had a look.
line.town.tc_ask_eat.1: Have you had lunch today at all? So thin.
line.town.tc_ask_eat.2: And have you eaten anything hot today?
line.town.tc_reply_eat_1.1: Good lad. The town's not the same on an empty stomach.
line.town.tc_reply_eat_1.2: Quite right. Soup is the foundation of everything.
line.town.tc_reply_eat_2.1: Forgot! Go and eat this minute. We'll finish talking after.
line.town.tc_reply_eat_2.2: You young people. The café's still serving, run along.
line.town.tc_ask_game.1: What do you play at the club?
line.town.tc_ask_game.2: You're from the club! What's everyone playing up there now?
line.town.tc_reply_game_1.1: Strategy's for brainy people. Will you teach me?
line.town.tc_reply_game_1.2: Oh, me too! Only I always get knocked out right at the start.
line.town.tc_reply_game_2.1: Watching's fun too. That's how I learn everything.
line.town.tc_reply_game_2.2: That's not fair, you've got to play! Come along, we'll play together.
line.town.dnc_floor.1: One-two-three, one-two-three… Just don't look at your feet.
line.town.dnc_floor.2: It's "Waves of the Amur"! Grandma learned to dance to this one.
line.town.dnc_floor.3: Who put the polka on again? I haven't got my breath back from the foxtrot.
line.town.dnc_floor.4: The ball's spinning, and my head's spinning faster.
line.town.dnc_floor.5: Dancing to a record is one thing, to a live band quite another.
line.town.dnc_floor_talk1.3: Then lead on the parquet, not on me.
line.town.dnc_floor_talk2.1: Will there be a ladies' choice?
line.town.dnc_floor_talk2.3: Then I'm not asking anyone until ten. Let them do it.
line.town.dnc_floor_talk3.2: The watchman says this one's the best. He's only got the one like it.
line.town.dnc_watch.1: In our day nobody hopped to a waltz. We glided.
line.town.dnc_watch.2: That couple there move well. Only he keeps counting with his lips.
line.town.dnc_watch.3: I sit and watch. Watching is a dance too, just a slow one.
line.town.dnc_watch.4: The tea at the buffet's strong tonight. That means the caretaker's in a good mood.
line.town.dnc_watch_grannies.1: I met my husband on this parquet. He was standing by the wall too, back then.
line.town.dnc_watch_grannies.2: I'll count who dances with whom; tomorrow there'll be plenty to talk about on the bench.
line.town.dnc_watch_talk1.1: Look, the Mamedov girl's dancing with everybody again.
line.town.dnc_watch_talk1.2: Let her. All we can do now is watch.
line.town.dnc_watch_talk1.3: What do you mean, all? When they call the ladies' choice, we'll see who gets asked.
line.town.dnc_watch_talk2.1: The band used to be five people.
line.town.dnc_watch_talk2.2: And now it's a pianist and a drummer on a stool.
line.town.dnc_hero_wall.1: Don't stand by the wall; the wall will stay up without you.
line.town.dnc_hero_wall.2: Ask someone! There are girls getting bored by the pillar.
line.town.dnc_hero_white.1: Ladies' choice! May I ask you? Don't say no, it isn't done.
line.town.dnc_hero_white.2: They've called the ladies' choice. Come on, my friends are already watching.
line.town.dnc_hero_white.3: You're standing by the pillar, so you're waiting. So here I am.
line.town.dnc_friend.1: {0}! You at the dance too? That's news. Tomorrow you'll tell me who you danced with.
line.town.dnc_friend.2: {0}, look: by the pillar there's the one who's been glancing at you all evening.
line.town.dnc_going1.3: If they pinch, you'll dance more carefully.
line.town.dnc_going2.1: Dances at seven. Got your comb?
line.town.dnc_going2.2: Got it. The wind will mess it all up anyway.
line.town.dnc_after.1: At the ladies' choice last night three girls asked the same boy. Three!
line.town.dnc_after.2: My legs are still aching from last night. That was the polka; it doesn't forgive.
line.town.dnc_after.3: The watchman threw everyone out at eleven sharp again last night. Like clockwork.
line.town.dnc_after_bench1.1: Did you see who walked home from the dance with whom last night?
line.town.dnc_after_bench1.2: I saw. And I saw who walked alone, too.
line.town.dnc_after_bench1.3: Never mind, they'll go again on Saturday.
line.town.dnc_after_bench2.1: Our boy got asked for the ladies' choice last night.
line.town.dnc_after_bench2.3: He won't say. Smiles and says nothing. So she must be nice.
line.town.rumour_dance_greet.1: They say you were the toast of the dance at the Vaults! And your partner was {1}, wasn't she?
line.town.rumour_dance_greet.2: Ah, the gallant! {1} is telling everybody you didn't once tread on her foot.
line.town.rumour_dance_greet_young.1: Is it true {1} danced with you? The whole class knows!
line.town.rumour_dance_greet_young.2: Sitting in a tree… All right, all right, I'll shut up. But {1}, that's true!
line.town.rumour_dance_friend.1: {0}, they say your partner at the dance was {1}. And not a word to me!
line.town.pev_floor.1: Under the open sky even a waltz is different. Wider, somehow.
line.town.pev_floor.2: The slabs are warm as a stove. You could dance till midnight.
line.town.pev_floor.3: The stars are out. Count stars, not steps, it's easier.
line.town.pev_floor.4: "Waves of the Amur" again. The volunteer doesn't know any other record.
line.town.pev_floor.5: Wind off the sea. Hold the music, hold your hat, hold me.
line.town.pev_floor_dusk.1: The lamps have come on, and the midges have come to the dance too.
line.town.pev_floor_dusk.2: A mosquito! Bit me right on the beat.
line.town.pev_floor_dusk.3: It's turned chilly. A cardigan would be nice, but the cardigan's at home and the dance is here.
line.town.pev_floor_dusk.4: The lighthouse is blinking in time. Or that's just me after the polka.
line.town.pev_floor_talk1.1: At the Vaults there's parquet, here it's slabs. Pity about my heels.
line.town.pev_floor_talk1.2: But here the ceiling is the sky.
line.town.pev_floor_talk2.2: At ten, by the lamp on the corner. The girls are already standing there.
line.town.pev_floor_talk3.2: Then they'll call it off and everyone will go home wet and happy.
line.town.pev_watch.1: Summer on the square, winter at the Vaults. That's how we lived, from dance to dance.
line.town.pev_watch.2: They used to lay boards here, a real floor. Now it's slabs, and never mind, they dance.
line.town.pev_watch.3: Look how he leads. He gets it from his father: he spent every summer spinning here too.
line.town.pev_watch_grannies.1: I met my husband on this square. He brushed a mosquito off my brow; that was all the introduction.
line.town.pev_watch_grannies.2: I've a sprig of lilac against the mosquitoes. And for looks.
line.town.pev_hero_wall.1: Don't stand by the fountain; the fountain plays without you. Ask someone!
line.town.pev_hero_wall.2: No time to be shy under the open sky: the summer's short.
line.town.pev_hero_white.1: Ladies' choice! Come on, before the lamp goes out.
line.town.pev_hero_white.2: I'm asking you. You can't say no under the stars; it's bad luck.
line.town.pev_band_play.1: One, two… "Waves of the Amur", from the upbeat. Trombones, don't rush.
line.town.pev_band_play.2: The mouthpiece got hot in the sun and burnt my lips. But the sound's golden.
line.town.pev_band_play.3: Peg your music down, there's a sea wind. Lose it in "Slavianka" and we'll never live it down.
line.town.pev_band_listen.1: "On the Hills of Manchuria". My mother used to cry to this waltz. A good kind of crying.
line.town.pev_band_listen.2: The tuba's on form today. The bandmaster must have promised him kvass.
line.town.pev_band_listen.3: The same programme every Sunday, and you never tire of it. Like the sea.
line.town.pev_band_listen.4: "Farewell of Slavianka" next. Up on your feet, whoever's sitting.
line.town.pev_band_listen_old.1: The band used to play here every evening. Now it's Sundays only, and even that's a treat.
line.town.pev_band_listen_old.2: I went off to the army to this march. And came back to the same one.
line.town.pev_band_talk1.1: Want an ice cream? The cart's down by the sea.
line.town.pev_band_talk1.2: After the polka. You can't miss the polka.
line.town.pev_band_talk2.2: The old one's grandson. The old one is in the front row, whispering the notes after him.
line.town.pev_band_kids.1: Catch me! Last one to the fountain is a tuba!
line.town.pev_band_kids.2: I'm going to be the drummer when I grow up. Boom! Boom!
line.town.pev_band_kids.3: Mum, can I have some kvass? Please, it's the band!
line.town.pev_band_hero.1: Sit with the little ones, on the slabs: you hear best from there.
line.town.pev_band_hero.2: Here for the march? Good lad. Whoever comes for the polka hears only half the programme.
line.town.pev_band_going1.2: At three, by the stage. If it doesn't rain.
line.town.pev_walk.1: To the pier and back. The whole town walks like that, and we're no worse.
line.town.pev_walk.2: In the evening on the promenade everybody says hello. Even those who don't by day.
line.town.pev_walk.3: Look, the sun's going down behind the town, and the sea's gone pink.
line.town.pev_walk.4: It smells of the sea and of roasted sunflower seeds. That's summer for you.
line.town.pev_walk_family1.1: Don't run ahead, hold on to the pram.
line.town.pev_walk_family1.2: Will we walk as far as the lighthouse?
line.town.pev_walk_family1.3: To the pier. The lighthouse will come to us when it lights up.
line.town.pev_walk_family2.1: We walked like this every evening when we first met.
line.town.pev_walk_family2.2: Only back then you didn't get tired.
line.town.pev_walk_family2.3: Back then the promenade was shorter, too.
line.town.pev_walk_teens.1: Shall we walk past the photo studio once more? She's there with her friends.
line.town.pev_walk_teens.2: One more round and home. Well, two more.
line.town.pev_bench.1: Shove up, this is the best seat for the sunset. I've been keeping it since spring.
line.town.pev_bench.2: Every bench is taken. A good evening, then.
line.town.pev_bench.3: I sit and watch them walk. That's a walk too, only sitting down.
line.town.pev_lighthouse.1: The lighthouse is lit! One… two… three… flash.
line.town.pev_lighthouse.2: When the lighthouse comes on, it's time to go home. And here we are still sitting.
line.town.pev_lighthouse.3: The promenade lamps come on one by one, as if somebody were walking along lighting them.
line.town.pev_photographer.1: Five more minutes and the light will be gone. The best there is, the evening light. Don't move!
line.town.pev_photographer.2: Not into the sun; but like that, half turned to the sea, it's pure gold.
line.town.pev_hero_evening.1: Good evening! Out for a walk? Quite right; on an evening like this staying in is a sin.
line.town.pev_hero_evening.2: Stand by the parapet when the lighthouse comes on. Make a wish and it'll come true.
line.town.pev_couple1.1: To the pier and back, like that time?
line.town.pev_couple1.2: Like that time. Only give me your arm, like that time.
line.town.pev_couple2.1: Shall we sit on our bench?
line.town.pev_couple2.2: If nobody's taken it again. In summer every bench is somebody's.
line.town.pev_going1.2: If it doesn't rain. I'll take a cardigan, it blows off the sea.
line.town.pev_going1.3: And eau de cologne for the mosquitoes.
line.town.pev_after.1: Danced on the square till eleven last night. Eaten by mosquitoes, and lovely all the same.
line.town.pev_after.2: The ladies' choice was under the lamp on the corner. I got asked. Under a lamp, imagine!
